module: 'Vehicle Aero Debug' window of the live Vehicle Editor. Enables the `aeroDebug` vehicle extension (extensions.aeroDebug.enable()), reads getAeroData() and displays the total aerodynamic force and moment (world frame and vehicle frame), then the downforce of the front/rear axles. Lets you associate the 4 wheels (FL, FR, RL, RR) via combos; an automatic fill is attempted if the wheel names are FL/FR/RL/RR. Depends on editor_veMain.
notes: Units: forces in N, moments in N·m, downforce percentages between axles.
aeroDebug is disabled on the vehicle side on vehicle change (old vehicle) and when the editor is deactivated.
The wheel values are sent to the vehicle via aeroDebug.setWheelNames(FL, FR, RL, RR) built by string concatenation; names containing a quote would break the command.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: enables/queries aeroDebug on the vehicle and draws the force tables and the axle configuration.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Disables aeroDebug on the old vehicle and resets the aero data and the combos initialization.

onEditorDeactivated.desc: Called when leaving the editor: disables aeroDebug on the current vehicle.

onEditorActivated.desc: Called when entering the editor (does nothing).
